contests.title: City of Plano, Texas — Proposition A

provenance.quote:
Proposition A
THIS IS A TAX INCREASE; Authorizing the City’s
venue project, specifically being a new multipurpose
arena for professional or amateur sports,
entertainment, and civic events in The Shops at
Willow Bend shopping mall area in the City, and
authorizing imposition of one or more of the following
for the purpose of financing the venue project: (1) a
short-term motor vehicle rental tax in the City at a
rate not to exceed 5%; (2) an event parking tax at the
venue project not to exceed $3.00 per vehicle; (3) an
event admissions tax at the venue project at a rate
not to exceed 10% of each ticket price; (4) a venue
facility use tax in an amount not to exceed $5,000 per
game on each member of a major league team that
plays a professional sports game at the venue
project; (5) a hotel occupancy tax in the City at a rate
not to exceed 2% of the room price. If approved, the
maximum hotel occupancy tax rate imposed from all
sources in the City of Plano would be 15% of the
price paid for a room in a hotel.

measures.questionText: THIS IS A TAX INCREASE; Authorizing the City’s venue project, specifically being a new multipurpose arena for professional or amateur sports, entertainment, and civic events in The Shops at Willow Bend shopping mall area in the City, and authorizing imposition of one or more of the following for the purpose of financing the venue project: (1) a short-term motor vehicle rental tax in the City at a rate not to exceed 5%; (2) an event parking tax at the venue project not to exceed $3.00 per vehicle; (3) an event admissions tax at the venue project at a rate not to exceed 10% of each ticket price; (4) a venue facility use tax in an amount not to exceed $5,000 per game on each member of a major league team that plays a professional sports game at the venue project; (5) a hotel occupancy tax in the City at a rate not to exceed 2% of the room price. If approved, the maximum hotel occupancy tax rate imposed from all sources in the City of Plano would be 15% of the price paid for a room in a hotel.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Actual current county All Race Ballot, five pages, explicitly Joint General and Special Election, November 3, 2026. Replays 49 local candidate offices and all 87 named printed choices plus 41 local questions. Six shared appellate offices and seven Dallas-area shared measures are crosschecked to existing prepared packets and not duplicated.
Official county current Sample Ballots page directly links this exact All Race Ballot. Native PDF bytes agree with the same unversioned county PDF. No personal voter lookup was used.
Official county election notices archive distinguishes current November 2026 material from prior 2025 and May2026 elections. Linked current jurisdiction orders/cancellations acquired separately.
Official appraisal district Board of Directors page explicitly identifies elected At-Large Places1,2,3 and links November3,2026 election information. No geographic place subdistricts created.
Official city November3,2026 Elections page directly links its four-ward map. Source ward labels preserved; no entire-city fallback for ward offices.
Official city council page lists geographic Ward1,2,3,4 offices separately. Sample provides the complete November candidate field for each ward.
Official Wylie ISD school board page explicitly says members are elected at large to four-year terms. Numbered places are offices within the district, not geographic subdistricts.
Official current district election page schedules November3,2026 election and links current election order.
Official NCES district directory resolves same-name Wylie ISDs: NCES4846530,StateTX-043914,CollinCounty,websitewylieisd.net. The TaylorCounty school district4846500 is not used.
Official City of Lavon ordinance2026-08-03 defines Lavon MDD as a portion of cityETJ shown in ExhibitA, not the city electorate. Exact district ID stays separate with boundary dependency.
Official current Collin CAD election order lists Places1,2,3 for November3,2026.
